column1: # The medicines: one row each, the owner's table (2026-10-31; srp-026g/docs/notes/medicines.md), each
# standing on its own. make_pack.py makes every config of it whole, from 0.26g's medkit.options, at
# gameplay/items/medicines/<name>.options.
# dict_id: bandages 66 and the Medikit 67 are 0.26g's rows (their configs repointed here by
# content-edit medicines-1, their base_cost the dictionary's); the coloured medkits' the donor's own,
# free in 0.26g and every pack (0.27d's 390 and 391; 0.46c2's 1196: its 759 and 760 are the Rattle's).
# key: the name and description keys are <key>_name and <key>_description
# (client-patches/localization/*.tsv).
# faction: who sells it (0: srp's prices.rs EXCEPTIONS row, the Scavengers; 2 Black Market,
# 3 Renaissance, 4 Fringe), from parameters/faction. level: item_level (the shop rank: Black Market the
# level, Renaissance and Fringe the level - 5); mm: match_making_level. cost: silver (base_cost).
# use, active: seconds before it heals, and how long it heals. kg: weight.
# limbs, body_head, pain, toxins: % of each pool it heals (arms and legs; body and head; pain;
# infection, the pool toxic and radiation damage drain): 100 heals 1 a second (0.26g's medkit, the
# body full in 1 s), less is that share of the pool over the active time.
# injuries: removes the limbs' injuries (hand_damage, leg_damage). toxins > 0 also takes away
# poisoning and radiation sickness.
# row, col: the icon's cell of LobbyMenu_AmmoIcons; source: stock (0.26g's own), 0.27d's atlas cell,
# or 0.46c2's single icon (donor.sha256).
# name
bandages
medkit
